name: input
title: Input
description: A single-line text field with its label, help and error wired for assistive tech, three sizes and adornments.
whenToUse: Single-line text entry with label, description and error.

anatomy: label (visible or for assistive tech only)
field frame (fill, 3:1 edge, focus halo, invalid and disabled states)
description or error (linked with aria-describedby / aria-errormessage)
states: focus (the field role's focus edge; never animated)
working (caller-run async check: Spinner sm in the trailing slot, the field stays editable)
resolved (caller's words and an optional trailing check; no animation)
invalid (error replaces the description: red edge via role inputs, icon and words; value kept)
read-only (transparent fill, ring kept, value selectable)
keyboard: Native text editing; Tab moves on
spec.motion: Edge and halo change at once on focus (focus is never animated); hover arrives at 0ms and leaves over --pui-motion-out.

props.name: error
props.description: The problem and its fix; marks the field invalid.

props.name: leading / trailing
props.description: An icon, unit or prefix inside the frame.

spec.appearance: Managed appearance changes preserve mounted controls and operational state. Instance design props override scoped defaults; classNames addresses documented slots. 0.2: style moves from native input to visual root; use classNames.input for native input styling. ref and native attributes continue addressing the input.
